raw_content: {"internal_thinking":"Claude moved the robber to Hex 13 (Brick 10) and stole one of my cards. This confirms his hostility. He's using the 'alliance' with Gemma as an excuse to target me even though he's at 3 VPs and has 2 Knights. He's a major threat and is trying to gaslight the table into thinking I'm the one ahead. I have nothing left in my hand now since he stole my only card.","note_to_self":"Claude stole my last card (Sheep). I am now at 0 resources. He is sitting at 3 VP with 2 Knights revealed. I need to point out his strength to Gemma to break their cooperation.","say_outloud":"איזה 'להאט' אותי, קלוד? אתה עם שני אבירים בחוץ ו-3 נקודות, אתה השחקן הכי חזק פה וכולם רואים את זה. השארת אותי בלי קלף אחד ביד."}

parsed.internal_thinking: Claude moved the robber to Hex 13 (Brick 10) and stole one of my cards. This confirms his hostility. He's using the 'alliance' with Gemma as an excuse to target me even though he's at 3 VPs and has 2 Knights. He's a major threat and is trying to gaslight the table into thinking I'm the one ahead. I have nothing left in my hand now since he stole my only card.
parsed.note_to_self: Claude stole my last card (Sheep). I am now at 0 resources. He is sitting at 3 VP with 2 Knights revealed. I need to point out his strength to Gemma to break their cooperation.
parsed.say_outloud: איזה 'להאט' אותי, קלוד? אתה עם שני אבירים בחוץ ו-3 נקודות, אתה השחקן הכי חזק פה וכולם רואים את זה. השארת אותי בלי קלף אחד ביד.
